title: Full of canonical Galois stalk functor
statement: Let $K,K_s,\Omega$ be fields in $\mathrm{Type}\,u$, with compatible algebra structures $K\to K_s\to\Omega$, $K_s$ a separable closure of $K$ [def-pd-separable-closure], and $\Omega$ algebraically closed. Let $J$ be the small etale topology on $\operatorname{Spec}K$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], let $p$ be the point defined by $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}K$, and let $p^*$ be its set-valued geometric stalk functor [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Put $G=\operatorname{Gal}(K_s/K)$ with the Krull topology and $w=\max(u+1,v)$. Let $U$ be the forgetful functor from discrete continuous $G$-sets in $\mathrm{Type}\,w$ to sets. Let $T:\operatorname{Sh}(J,\mathrm{Type}\,w)\to\operatorname{DiscreteContAction}(\mathrm{Type}\,w,G)$ be a functor, and $j:T\circ U\cong p^*$ a natural isomorphism satisfying the canonical germ formula. The canonical germ formula is: for a sheaf $F$, $g\in G$, a $K$-automorphism $\tau$ of $\Omega$ with $\tau\circ i=i\circ g$ for the embedding $i:K_s\to\Omega$, an etale $K$-scheme $X$, lifts $x,x^{\prime}:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ over $K$ with $x^{\prime}=x\circ\operatorname{Spec}\tau$, and $z\in F(X)$, $j_F(g\cdot j_F^{-1}(\operatorname{germ}_x z))=\operatorname{germ}_{x^{\prime}}z$. Then $T$ is full.

proof.text: Given a morphism a:T(F)->T(F'), transport its underlying function through j to q:p^*F->p^*F'. For every etale object X and section z of F(X), the family x |-> q(germ_x z) satisfies the covariance hypothesis of [lem-exc-field-equivariant-germ-family-section], by the canonical germ formula for F and F' and equivariance of a. Apply that lemma to obtain a section of F'(X) with precisely these germs.

Prove directly that sections over an etale K-scheme are determined by their germs at lifts to Omega. For each underlying point, Mathlib Scheme.exists_fac_of_etale_of_isSepClosed supplies such a lift. Equal germs agree on a pointed refinement by Point.toPresheafFiber_eq_iff'. Thus the section equalizer sieve covers every underlying point. The criterion Scheme.ofArrows_mem_smallEtaleTopology_iff makes it covering, and Sheaf.isSeparated gives equality, including for the empty scheme. This is the private proved helper field_section_germ_ext, adapting the existing faithfulness argument.

The local section from step 1 is unique by step 2; explicitly establish ExistsUnique before choosing it. The chosen sections therefore carry no arbitrary unproved data. Naturality of their germs under restriction is Point.toPresheafFiber_w_apply. Both possible section restrictions have the same germs, so step 2 proves that the section functions form a natural transformation, hence a sheaf morphism phi.

Point.presheafFiber_hom_ext and Point.toPresheafFiber_naturality_apply show that the stalk map of phi equals q: the equality holds on every section germ by construction. Naturality of j and its inverse identities then give equality between the underlying functions of T(phi) and a. The forgetful functor through the two full subcategory inclusions and Action.forget is faithful, so T(phi)=a. This provides a preimage of every morphism and proves T.Full.

lean.statement:
theorem galoisStalkActionFunctor_full
    (K Ks Ω : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ks] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra K Ks] [IsSepClosure K Ks] [Algebra Ks Ω] [Algebra K Ω]
    [IsScalarTower K Ks Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] :
    let S := Spec (.of K); let J := S.smallEtaleTopology
    let s := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)); let p := pointSmallEtale s
    let G := Gal(Ks/K); let V := ObjectProperty.ι (ContAction.IsDiscrete
      (V := Type (max (u + 1) v)) (G := G)) ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (Action.IsContinuous
      (V := Type (max (u + 1) v)) (G := G))
    ∀ (T : Sheaf J (Type (max (u + 1) v)) ⥤ DiscreteContAction (Type (max (u + 1) v)) G)
      (j : T ⋙ V ⋙ Action.forget (Type (max (u + 1) v)) G ≅ p.sheafFiber),
      (∀ (F : Sheaf J (Type (max (u + 1) v))) (g : G) (τ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω)
          (hτ : (algebraMap Ks Ω).comp g.toRingHom = τ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Ks Ω))
          (X : S.Etale) (x x' : p.fiber.obj X)
          (hx : x'.left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ.toRingHom) ≫ x.left)
          (z : F.obj.obj (op X)),
        (j.hom.app F) ((T.obj F).obj.obj.ρ g ((j.inv.app F) (p.toPresheafFiber X x F.obj z))) =
          p.toPresheafFiber X x' F.obj z) → T.Full
